### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>sigstore/sigstore (github.com/sigstore/sigstore)</summary>

### [`v1.10.9`](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/releases/tag/v1.10.9)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/compare/v1.10.8...v1.10.9)

#### What's Changed

Note: [#​2369](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2369) deprecates the TUF client. Use the TUF client from sigstore-go instead: <https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore-go/tree/main/pkg/tuf>

- Deprecate TUF client, ValidatePubKey in [#​2369](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2369)
- docs: add OVHcloud KMS in available external plugins in [#​2359](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2359)
- fix(oauthflow): default the device flow poll interval to 5s per RFC 8628 in [#​2381](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2381)
- Add BrowserOpener field to InteractiveIDTokenGetter in [#​2383](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2383)
- Fix Azure KMS support for RSA signatures in [#​2355](https://redirect.github.com/sigstore/sigstore/pull/2355)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/sigstore/sigstore/compare/v1.10.8...v1.10.9>

</details>
